title: Nav bar light mode
summary: Light-mode variant of the main nav rail (Main_nav light mode) on the Copilot landing page: collapsed rail, expanded rail, and the account menu opened from the footer avatar in both rail widths. Content area is identical in every frame (Hello Roger, landing input box, Connect apps banner carousel). Frame names in Figma: 208, 209, 210, 1730.

steps.action: Open the app / land on New Session with the rail collapsed.
steps.nav: light, collapsed (56px icon rail), New Session item selected
steps.panels: none; landing composer visible, no artifact/side panel, no modal
components: Copilot desktop Input Box {Type=Landing Page, State=Default, Tools & Sources=Yes, Text=Placeholder, Attachment=No}

steps.changedFrom: Rail expands from icons to full labels; content shifts right and recentres in the remaining width. A Routines row ('Excel Formula Help From Main Docu...') shows a hover background.
steps.action: Click the expand control on the collapsed rail (logo / sidebar toggle) to expand it.
steps.nav: light, expanded (280px); New Session selected; Agents and Pinned groups with right chevron, Routines and History with down chevron
components: Copilot desktop Input Box {Type=Landing Page, State=Default, Tools & Sources=Yes, Text=Placeholder, Attachment=No}

openQuestions: Collapsed account menu (step 03) has a Notifications row with an unread dot; the expanded one (step 04) does not. Is Notifications meant to appear in both?
Which control expands the collapsed rail: the logo, a hover-to-peek, or a dedicated toggle? The collapsed frame shows no explicit toggle (expanded has the sidebar icon next to search).
Is step order 01 -> 02 -> 03 -> 04 a single flow, or two pairs (collapsed/expanded rail, then account menu in each width)? Read here as two pairs.
Light rail lists the History group; the dark rail in nav-behaviour calls the same group 'Chats'. Which label is current?
